answer: Start from capability token with proof of work. Every identity must clear it before its first answer counts. Scale is the enemy of the attacker here: 679 aliases need 679 independent proofs, and one failed proof burns the whole cluster's bond. The bridge sits in the mechanism itself, the wander sits in the price of faking it, and the orchard sits in the record no template can forge. One mechanism, one cost, one public record — and the farm's maths stops adding up.
